NovaTech Solutions was founded in 2019 in Lahore by Ayesha Khan.
NovaTech's main product is TaskFlow, a project management tool for small businesses.
TaskFlow Basic plan costs $10 per user per month.
TaskFlow Pro plan costs $25 per user per month and includes analytics.
NovaTech support is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM PKT.
NovaTech has 45 employees across offices in Lahore and Karachi.
TaskFlow integrates with Slack, Google Calendar and GitHub.
NovaTech offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
